reason: A DSH web plugin that visualizes machine-local token usage through daily and weekly heatmaps, backed by a local SQLite projection and optional maintenance CLI.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 中通过日视图和周热力图展示本机各项目的令牌使用量，并使用本地 SQLite 保存用量投影。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that displays machine-local token usage in daily and weekly heatmaps using a local SQLite projection.

capabilities: Reads local DSH session usage data
Projects usage facts into a local SQLite database
Serves a local snapshot endpoint for the dashboard
Provides local maintenance commands including rebuild, backup, restore, and cleanup
